name: Hefei Gocom Information Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hefei Gocom Information Technology Co.,Ltd. is a Chinese company specializing in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of advanced signaling and intelligent dispatching systems for industrial railway applications. Their offerings also encompass monitoring solutions for narrow-gauge industrial rail transport and comprehensive information system integration services. These products are widely utilized across a diverse range of sectors, including metallurgy, mining, petrochemicals, port operations, power generation, and urban rail transit, specifically serving dedicated and specialized railway lines. The company, headquartered in Hefei, China, was established in 2000.
